The script is a template containing multiple placeholder values (`__WORKDIR__`, `__SAMPLETYPE__`, etc.). As the comment correctly identifies, these must be replaced before submission, or the script will fail at runtime.

The script is extremely non-portable. It depends on a specific `scram` environment at an absolute AFS path, relies on a user-specific `$PhysicsWorkspace` variable, and hardcodes paths throughout. It will not work outside of this very specific user environment.

#!/bin/sh --login

# Flux directives translated from LSF
#FLUX: -q 1nd
#FLUX: -n 1
#FLUX: -t 1:00:00

#
# --- Omitted LSF options and explanations ---
#
# Note: The original LSF script did not request any specific resources like time,
# nodes, or cores. Sensible defaults (-n 1, -t 1:00:00) have been added.
#

# CRITICAL: This script is a template. The placeholder values __WORKDIR__,
# __SAMPLETYPE__, __ID__, and __INPUT__ must be replaced with actual values
# before submission. Failure to do so will cause the script to fail.

WorkDir=__WORKDIR__
SampleType=__SAMPLETYPE__
ID=__ID__

export SCRAM_ARCH=slc6_amd64_gcc630
cd /afs/cern.ch/work/c/chenyi/CMSSW/CMSSW_10_3_0/src/
eval `scramv1 runtime -sh`
cd - > /dev/null

export X509_USER_PROXY=$PhysicsWorkspace/HI2018HLT/CommonCode/proxy/x509up_proxy
echo $X509_USER_PROXY

Template=$WorkDir/ExportedMenuPFNewTrackingV4.py

FileList=`echo "__INPUT__" | tr '@' ' ' | sed "s/[ ,]*$//"`

echo "List of files = $FileList"
echo "ID = $ID"
echo "Sample = $SampleType"

cat $Template \
   | sed "s#__FILE__#$FileList#g" \
   > RunJob.py
cat RunJob.py | bzip2 > $WorkDir/Result/RunJob_${SampleType}_${ID}.py.bz2

cp $WorkDir/setup_dev_CMSSW_10_3_0_HLT_cff.py .

cp -r $WorkDir/Sample* .

mkdir -p $WorkDir/Result/

cmsRun RunJob.py >& Log_${ID}
bzip2 Log_${ID}
mv Log_${ID}.bz2 $WorkDir/Result/Log_${SampleType}_${ID}.bz2
mv openHLT.root $WorkDir/Result/openHLT_${SampleType}_${ID}.root
